applications.source_text: ወ*እሜሃ፡ ሐወጹ፡ ሚካኤል፡ *ወኡርኤል፡ ወሩፋኤል ወገብርኤል፡ እምሰማይ፤ ወርእዩ፡ ብዙሐ፡ ደመ፡ ዘይትከዓው፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር።
applications.english: Then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being poured out upon the earth, and all the lawlessness being committed upon the earth.[a][b]

applications.source_text: ወይቤሉ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ቃለ፡ ጽራኃቲሆሙ፡ ዐረቀ፡ ጸርሐት፡ ምድር። እስከ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ሰማይ፡
applications.english: And they said among themselves, “The voice of their cry has ascended, and the earth has cried out as far as the gate of heaven.”[a]

applications.source_text: [ወይእዜኒ፡ ለክሙ፡ ለቅዱሳነ፡ ሰማይ፡] ይስእዩ፡ ነፍሳተ፡ ሰብእ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብሉ፡ አብኡ፡ ለነ፡ ፍትሐ፡ *ኀበ፡ ልዑል፡
applications.english: And now the souls of human beings appeal to you, holy ones of heaven, saying, “Present our case before the Most High.”[a][b]

applications.source_text: ወይቤሉ፡ ለ*እግዚኦሙ፡ †ለነገሥት፡ እስመ፡† እግዚኦሙ፡ ለአጋእዝት፡ ወአምላኮሙ፡ ለአማልክት፡ ወንጉሦሙ፡ ለነገሥት፡ ወመንበረ፡ ስብሐቲከ፡ ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ *ትውልደ፡ ዓለም፡ ወ*ስምከ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ወስቡሕ፡ *ውስተ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓለም፡ ወቡሩክ፡ [ወከቡድ፡]
applications.english: And they said to their Lord:[a] “Lord of lords, God of gods, and King of kings, the throne of your glory endures throughout all generations of the world. Your name is holy and glorious throughout the whole world, and is blessed and honored.”[b][c][d]

applications.source_text: አንተ፡ ገበርከ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወ*ስልጣነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምስሌከ፡ ወ*ኵሉ፡ ክሡት፡ ቅድሜከ፡ ወግሁድ፡ *ወአንተ፡ ትሬኢ፡ ኵሎ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይትከሀል፡ ይትኀባእ፡ እምኔከ።
applications.english: You made everything, and dominion over everything is with you. Everything is uncovered before you and manifest. You see everything, and nothing can hide itself from you.

applications.source_text: ርኢከ፡ ዘገብረ፡ አዛዝኤል፡ ዘመሀረ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዓመፃ፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወአግሀደ፡ ኅቡኣተ፡ ዓለም፡ †እለ፡ ይትገበሩ፡ በሰማያት፡ አመረ፡ ሰብእ።
applications.english: You have seen what Azazel has done: he taught all lawlessness on the earth and revealed the secrets of eternity—those that are carried out in the heavens—and humankind came to know them.[a]

applications.source_text: (ወዘ)ስምያዛ፡ ዘአንተ፡ ወሀብኮ፡ ስልጣነ፡ ይኵንን፡ እለ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ኅቡረ።
applications.english: And as for Semyaza, you gave him authority to rule over those who were together with him.[a]

applications.source_text: ወሖሩ፡ ኀበ፡ አዋልደ፡ ሰብእ፡ *በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወስከቡ፡ *ምስሌሆን፡ ምስለ፡ እልኩ፡ አንስት፡ ወረኵሱ፡ ወአግሀዱ፡ *ሎን፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአተ።
applications.english: And they went to the daughters of humankind on the earth and lay with them—with those women—and defiled themselves, and revealed to them every sin.

applications.source_text: ወአንስትሰ፡ ወለዳ፡ ረዓይተ፡ በዘ፡ መልአት፡ *ኵላ፡ ምድር፡ ደመ፡ ወዓመፃ፡
applications.english: And the women gave birth to giants; through this, the whole earth was filled with blood and violence.[a]

applications.source_text: ወይእዜኒ፡ ናሁ፡ ይጸርኁ፡ ነፍሰ፡ እለ፡ ሞቱ፡ ወይስእዩ፡ እስከ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ሰማይ፤ ወዓርገ፡ ገዓሮሙ፡ ወኢይክል፡ ወጺአ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡
applications.english: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died cry out and make their appeal as far as the gate of heaven. Their lament has ascended and cannot cease because of the lawlessness being committed upon the earth.[a]

applications.source_text: ወአንተ፡ ታአምር፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይኩን፡ ወአንተ፡ ታአምር፡ ዘንተ፡ †ወዘዚአሆሙ፡† ወአልቦ፡ ዘትነግረነ፡ ምንት፡ መፍትው፡ ንረስዮሙ፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ።
applications.english: You know everything before it comes to be, and you know this and what belongs to them.[a] Yet you have not told us what we should do to them concerning this.[b]

applications.source_text: አሜሃ፡ ልዑል፡ (ይቤ፡) ዓቢይ፡ ወቅዱስ፡ ተናገረ፡ ወፈነወ፡ አሰርየ፡ ልዩር፡ ኀበ፡ ወልደ፡ ላሜክ፡ ወ*ይቤሎ፤
applications.english: Then the Most High, the Great and Holy One, spoke and sent Asaryalyur to the son of Lamech, and said to him:[a][b]

applications.source_text: (ሖር፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወ) በሎ፡ በስመ፡ ዚአየ፡ ኅባእ፡ ርእሰከ፡ ወአግህድ፡ ሎቱ፡ ፍጻሜ፡ ዘይመጽእ፡ እስመ፡ ይትኃጐል፡ ምድር፡ ኵሉ፡ ወማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ይመጽእ፡ ሀሎ፡ ዲበ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወያኀጕል፡ ዘሀሎ፡ ውስቴታ።
applications.english: Go to Noah and say to him in my name, “Hide yourself!” Then reveal to him the end that is coming, for the whole earth will be destroyed. The waters of a flood are about to come over the whole earth and destroy everything that is in it.[a]

applications.source_text: ወይእዜኒ፡ መሀሮ፡ ከመ፡ ይጐይዝ፡ ወይገበር፡ ዘርኡ፡ ለኵሎሙ፡ ትውልድ፡ ለዓለም።
applications.english: And now instruct him, so that he may escape and establish his offspring for all generations forever.[a][b]

applications.source_text: ወይቤ፡ [ካዕበ፡] እግዚእ፡ ለሩፋኤል፡ እሰሮ፡ ለአዛዝኤል፡ በእዴሁ፡ ወእግሩ፡ ወድዮ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወአብቅዋ፡ ለገዳም፡ እንተ፡ ሀለወት፡ በዱዳኤል፡ ወድዮ፡ ህየ፡
applications.english: Again the Lord said to Raphael, “Bind Azazel by his hands and feet, and cast him into darkness. Make an opening in the wilderness that is in Dudael, and cast him there.”[a][b]

applications.source_text: ወ*ደይ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ እብነ፡ ጠያያተ፡ ወበሊሓተ፡ ወክድኖ፡ ጽልመተ፡ ወህየ፡ ይኅድር፡ ለዓለም፤ ወ*ክድኖ፡ ለገጹ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይርአይ፡ ብርሃነ።
applications.english: Place rough and sharp stones over him, cover him with darkness, and let him remain there forever. Cover his face so that he may not see light.

applications.source_text: ወበዕለት፡ *ዓባይ፡ እንተ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ከመ፡ ይትፈኖ፡ ውስተ፡ ዋዕይ፡
applications.english: And on the great day of judgment, let him be cast into the burning heat.[a]

applications.source_text: ወአሕይዋ፡ ለምድር፡ እንተ፡ አማሰኑ፡ መላእክት፡ ወሕይወታ፡ ለምድር፡ አይድዕ፡ ከመ፡ ይሕይ(ው)ዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወ*ኢይትሐጐሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ በምሥጢር፡ ኵሉ፡ †ዘቀተሉ፡† ትጉሃን፡ ወመሀሩ፡ ለውሉዶሙ።
applications.english: Bring the earth, which the angels corrupted, back to life, and proclaim life to the earth, so that it may live and all the children of humanity may not perish because of all the mysteries[a] that the Watchers [disclosed] and taught to their children.

applications.source_text: ወማሰነት፡ ኵላ፡ ምድር፡ *በትምህርተ፡ ግብሩ፡ ለአዛዝኤል፡ ወላዕሌሁ፡ ጸሐፍ፡ ኵሎ፡ ኃጢአተ።
applications.english: The whole earth has been corrupted through the teaching of Azazel’s practices. Record every sin against him.[a]

applications.source_text: ወለገብርኤል፡ ይቤሎ፡ እግዚእ፡ ሑር፡ ዲቤሆሙ፡ ለመንዝራን፡ ወለማኑናን፡ *ወዲበ፡ ውሉደ፡ ዘማ፡ ወ*አኅጕሎሙ፡ [ለውሉደ፡ ዘማ፡ ወ]ለውሉደ፡ ትጉሃን፡ እምሰብእ፡ ወአውፅኦሙ፡ [ወፈንዎሙ፡] በበይናቲሆሙ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወስሊሆሙ፡ በቀትል፡ ይትሐጐሉ፡ እስመ፡ ኑሐ፡ መዋዕል፡ አልቦሙ።
applications.english: And the Lord said to Gabriel, “Go against the illegitimate offspring[a] and the outcasts, and against the children of fornication. Destroy the children of fornication[b] and the children of the Watchers from among humankind. Drive them out and send them[c] against one another, so that they destroy one another in battle, for they will have no length of days.”

applications.source_text: ወእሉ፡ ዘይስእሉከ፡ [ወ]ኢይከውኑ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ፡ በእንቲአሆሙ፡ እስመ፡ ይሴፈዉ፡ ይኅየዉ፡ ሕይወተ፡ ዘለዓለም፡ ወከመ፡ ይሕየዉ፡ አሐዱ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምኔሆሙ፡ ኃምስተ፡ ምእተ፡ ክረምተ።
applications.english: And what they ask of you shall not be granted to their fathers on their behalf, because they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.[a][b][c]

applications.source_text: ወለሚካኤል፡ ይቤ፡ *እግዚእ፡ ሑር፡ †አይድዕ፡ †ለስምያዛ፡ ወለካልኣን፡ እለ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ እለ፡ ሐብሩ፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ከመ፡ ይማስኑ፡ ምስሌሆን፡ በ ርኵሶ፡ ዚአሆን።
applications.english: And the Lord said to Michael, “Go, make known to Semyaza and the others who are with him,[a] who joined themselves to women so that they defiled themselves with them in their impurity.”

applications.source_text: ወ ሶበ፡ ይትራገዙ፡ ኵሉ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ወሶበ፡ ይሬእዩ፡ ሐጕሎሙ፡ ለፍቁራኒሆሙ፡ እሰሮሙ፡ ለ፸ ትውልድ፡ በመትሕተ፡ አውግርተ፡ ምድር፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኵነኔሆሙ፡ ወተፍጻሜቶሙ፡ *እስከ፡ ይትፌጸም፡ ኵነኔ፡ ዘለ*ዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
applications.english: And when all their sons have slaughtered one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them for seventy generations beneath the valleys of the earth, until the day of their judgment and their consummation—until the judgment that is forever and ever is completed.[a][b]

applications.source_text: ወበውእቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይወስድዎሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መትሕተ፡ እሳት፡ (ወ) በጻዕር፡ ወበቤት፡ ሞቅሕ፡ ወ ይትዓፀዉ፡ ለ ዓለም።
applications.english: On that day they will take them into the depths of fire, into torment and a prison-house, and they will be shut up forever.[a][b]

applications.source_text: ወሶበ፡ †ይውዒ፡† ወይማስን፡ እምይእዜ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ይትአሰሩ፡ እስከ፡ ተፍጻሜተ፡ ትውልደ፡ ትውልድ።
applications.english: And when one burns and is destroyed,[a] from then on they will be bound together with them until the completion of generation after generation.[b]

applications.source_text: ወአኅጕሎሙ፡ ለእሉ፡ *መናፍስተ፡ ተውኔት፡ ወለውሉዶሙ፡ ለትጉሃን፡ እስመ፡ ገፍዕዎሙ፡ ለሰብእ።
applications.english: Destroy all these spirits of illegitimate birth and the offspring of the Watchers, because they have oppressed humanity.[a][b]

applications.source_text: አሕጕል፡ ኵሎ፡ ግፍዓ፡ እምገጸ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሉ፡ ምግባረ፡ እኩይ፡ ይኅልቅ፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ተክለ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወርትዕ፡ ወይከውን፡ ለበረከት፤ ግብረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወርትዕ፡ ለዓለም፡ በፍሥሓ፡ ይተከሉ፡፡
applications.english: Destroy all oppression from the face of the earth, and let every evil deed come to an end. Then the plant of righteousness and uprightness will appear and become a blessing; deeds of righteousness and uprightness will be planted forever in joy.[a]

applications.source_text: ወይእዜኒ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ይጐይዩ፡ ወይከውኑ፡ ሕያዋነ፡ እስከ፡ ይወልዱ፡ ፲፻፡ ወኵሎ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ውርዝውቶሙ፡ ወሰንበተ፡ ዚአሆሙ፡ ይፌጽሙ፡ በሰላም።
applications.english: And now all the righteous will escape and remain alive until they beget a thousand children; and they will complete all the days of their youth and their old age in peace.[a][b][c]

applications.source_text: ወበእማንቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ትትገበር፡ ኵላ፡ ምድር፡ በጽድቅ፡ ወእስንታሃ፡ ትትከል፡ ዕጸወ፡ ወትመልእ፡ በረከተ።
applications.english: In those days the whole earth will be cultivated in righteousness; the whole of it will be planted with trees and filled with blessing.[a]

applications.source_text: ወኵሉ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ትሤት፡ ይተከሉ፡ ዲቤሃ፡ ወይተክሉ፡ ዲቤሃ፡ አውያነ፡ ወወይን፡ ዘይትከል፡ ዲቤሃ፡ ይገብር፡ ወይነ፡ ለጽጋብ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘርእ፡ ዘይዘራእ፡ ዲቤሃ፡ አሐቲ፡ መስፈርት፡ ትገብር፡ እልፈ፡ ወአሐቲ፡ መስፈርት፡ ኤልያስ፡ ትገብር፡ ፲ምክያደ፡ ዘይት።
applications.english: And every delightful tree shall be planted upon it, and vineyards shall be planted upon it. The vine planted upon it shall produce wine in abundance. Every seed sown upon it—one measure shall produce ten thousand; and one measure of olives shall produce ten presses of oil.[a][b][c][d]

applications.source_text: ወአንተ፡ አንጽሓ፡ ለምድር፡ እምኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ረሲዕ፤ ወኵሉ፡ ርኵስ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ አኅልቆሙ፡ እምዲበ፡ ምድር።
applications.english: And you, cleanse the earth from every oppression, from every act of lawlessness, from every sin, and from every wickedness; and eradicate from the earth every defilement committed upon it.

applications.source_text: ወይኩኑ፡ ኵሉ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጻድቃነ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ያምልኩ፡ ወይባርኩ፡ ኪያየ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ሊተ፡ ይሰግዱ።
applications.english: May all the children of humanity be righteous; may all the nations worship and bless me, and may they all bow down to me.[a]

applications.source_text: ወትነጽሕ፡ ምድር፡ እምኵሉ፡ ሙስና፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ኃጢአት፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ወእምኵሉ፡ ጻዕር፤ ወኢይደግም፡ ከመ፡ እፈኑ፡ ዲቤሃ፡ ለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም።
applications.english: The earth will be cleansed of all corruption, all sin, all plague, and all suffering; and never again will I send these things upon it, from generation to generation and forever.[a][b]
